title: Three Years and One Short Gate
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：institute　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 institute 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the principal ① founded the institute that no student in the campus would have recorded, and he said the founding was the whole of the year. The ② institute, meaning the school itself and not the sign, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a institute, he said, is the only thing in a campus that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ institute in that campus had the same short sign beside it, and the ④ institute at the far hall, meaning the course they kept for the children to choose and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A institute, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the principal said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the institute was the whole of the matter, meaning the training and not the school. The ⑥ institute, meaning the training and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; institute, he said, is either something you found or the only word that means both a school and a training. He said the training is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ institute had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short sign. The ⑧ institute of the whole thing, the principal wrote in September, was one campus and three years of recording; institute, he said, is either the course at the far hall or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ institute I remember is the school recorded in the plan, which closed in 1981 and is still recorded as the quietest in the campus. A ⑩ institute, my mother said in 1983, is the only school that improves by being recorded; every institute, she said, is a training that has agreed to look like a school. She said the training was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 学院；研究所（指院区里每一所旁边的那一所）
B. n. 学院；研究所（指那所学院本身，与牌匾相对）
C. 固定搭配：found the institute 创办这所学院
D. n. 学院；研究所（指留给孩子们选的那一门那一所）
E. n. 研修之事（抽象总称，指一处院区的学院之事）
F. n. 学院；研究所（指计划书里写到、被记下的的那一所）
G. n. 培训、培养（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 培养（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: founded the institute that no student in the campus would have recorded
The institute, meaning the school itself and not the sign
the institute at the far hall
the institute was the whole of the matter
the institute had become a line in a plan
The institute of the whole thing
A institute, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: found the institute 意为“创办这所学院”，1974 年那位院长把院区里没有一位学员肯记录的一所学院做了一遍。
institute 意为“学院；研究所”，指那所学院本身而不是牌匾，它经过了三个年而在簿子上没有被记录。
institute 意为“学院；研究所”，指院区里每一所旁边的那一所，每一所旁边都有同一块小小的牌匾。
institute 意为“学院；研究所”，指最远那座礼堂留给孩子们选的那一门那一所，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
institute 意为“培训、培养”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份培养就是那件事的全部。
institute 意为“培养”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那所学院，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
institute 意为“学院；研究所”，指计划书里写到、被记下的的那一所，到 1979 年这一所成了计划书里的一行。
institute 意为“研修之事”，院长九月写道，整件事的学院之事是一处院区和三个年的记录。
institute 意为“学院；研究所”，我记得的是计划书里记录过的那一所，1981 年挂牌了，至今仍被说成院区里最安静的一所。
institute 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，学院是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的学院。
